'''Frostbite''' is a [[mod]] that increases both the {{D|Cold}} damage and [[status chance]] of a sidearm by 15% per rank for a maximum of 60% at rank 3.

==Acquisition==
*This mod can be acquired as a random end-of mission reward for a successful [[Spy]] mission with all 3 Data Vaults hacked.
*Drop Locations:
{{MissionTable|Rosalind|Nereid|Kelpie|Oceanum|Pago}}
*Originally this mod could be acquired from [[Operation Cryotic Front]] by scoring more than 1000 points in a single mission.

==Drop Locations==
{{DropLocations}}

==Notes==
*'''Frostbite''' is additive with similar mods. For example, a {{Weapon|Sicarus}} with a max rank '''Frostbite''' and {{M|Sure Shot}} will have a {{Math|6% {{mul}} (1 + 60% + 90%)|t = y|p = y}} status chance.
*This mod can be combined with {{M|Jolt}}, {{M|Pistol Pestilence}} and {{M|Scorch|Scorch}} to achieve a combined status chance bonus of 240%. With {{M|Sure Shot}} and {{M|Stunning Speed}}, this bonus can be increased to 360%. With {{M|Saxum Spittle}}, {{M|Jugulus Spines}}, and {{M|Carnis Stinger}}, this bonus can be increased to 540%.

'''Frail Momentum''' is a [[Corrupted Mods|Corrupted Mod]] that increases the [[fire rate]] of shotguns at the cost of damage by 15% and -2.5% per rank at a maximum of 90% and -15% at rank 5, respectively.

==Notes==
*Can be combined with {{M|Shotgun Barrage}} and {{M|Accelerated Blast}} to provide a '''240%''' increase in fire rate.
*Unlike {{M|Anemic Agility}} and {{M|Vile Acceleration}}, Frail Momentum gives the same amount of fire rate as the non-corrupt equivalent, Shotgun Barrage . As such, Frail Momentum should only be used in conjunction with Shotgun Barrage in builds aiming to maximize fire rate.
*The negative damage boost is additive with other damage boosting mods such as {{M|Point Blank}}. Combining a maxed Point Blank (+90% damage) with Frail Momentum will result in a total damage bonus of +75%.
**The actual net damage loss when combined with a maxed Point Blank is 7.9%.
**The actual net damage loss when combined with a maxed {{M|Primed Point Blank}} is 5.7%.

*When calculating total raw damage, a weapon will require an Impact damage percentage equal to 75% of its total base damage to equal the raw damage increase provided by a standard elemental mod (which increases corresponding elemental damages by 90%). These calculations only pertain to raw damage, and do not take into consideration enemy armor/flesh/shield damage multipliers.
**The only weapons that are at or above the 75% Impact damage percentage are {{Weapon|Sobek}} and {{Weapon|Sweeper}} /[[Sweeper Prime|Prime]].

{{WeaponInfoboxAutomatic}}
{{Codex|Silently lacerate enemies with Gara's signature glass throwing knives. Increased Projectile Speed when wielded by Gara.}}
The '''Fusilai''' are {{WF|Gara}}'s [[Signature Weapon|signature]] throwing knives, featuring high {{D|Slash}} damage, high [[critical chance]] and [[status chance]], and fast [[reload speed]], but with poor [[fire rate]] and low magazine capacity. The [[Alternate Fire]] is a semi-automatic fire that throws three knives horizontally with increased status chance, but with significantly lower critical chance and fire rate, as well as being unsilenced. The knives fly faster when thrown by Gara.

==Characteristics==
*This weapon deals primarily {{D|Slash}} damage.
*Primary fire throws a single knife in a fully automatic fashion.
**Second highest [[critical chance]] of all throwing-type secondaries, behind {{Weapon|Spira}} and {{Weapon|Spira Prime}}.
**Second highest [[status chance]] of all throwing-type secondaries, behind {{Weapon|Pox}}.
**[[Noise Level|Silent]].
*[[Alternate Fire]] throws three knives in a fan shape in a semi-automatic fashion.
**Good overall [[status chance]].
**Innate [[multishot]] of 3 knives.
**Very wide spread.
**Consumes 3 ammo per throw.
**Only throwing-type secondary with an "Alarming" noise level.
*Can use the thrown-exclusive mod {{M|Concealed Explosives}}.

{{Advantages|
*Pinpoint [[accuracy]].
}}

{{Disadvantages|
*Projectiles have travel time with arcing.
*Primary Fire has third lowest fire rate of all throwing-type secondaries, behind {{Weapon|Pox}} and {{Weapon|Spira}}.
*Alternate Fire has lowest [[fire rate]] of all throwing-type secondaries.
*Third smallest magazine size of all throwing-type secondaries, behind {{Weapon|Pox}}/{{Weapon|Talons}} and {{Weapon|Castanas}}/{{Weapon|Sancti Castanas}}.
}}

==Acquisition==
The Fusilai's blueprint can be purchased from the [[Market]].

{{BuildAutomatic|type=Weapon}}
This weapon can be sold for {{cc|5,000}}.

==Notes==
*As a [[Signature Weapon]], Fusilai gains a bonus effect with {{WF|Gara}} or {{WF|Gara Prime}}, gaining '''50%''' increased [[Projectile Speed]].
*The Fusilai's [[Alternate Fire]] instantly fires a horizontal spread of three knives, costing three ammo. The knives have the same base damage as the primary fire but have decreased [[status chance]] (12.3%), reduced [[fire rate]] (1.5), and drastically reduced [[critical chance]] (3%), as well as having an alarming noise level.
**The alternate fire cannot be used if the magazine has less than 3 ammo remaining.
**Despite the alt-fire being unsilenced, it does not uncloak {{WF|Ivara}}'s {{A|Prowl}}.
*The knives will, similar to arrows and bolts, stick to walls and enemies and disappear after a short time.

==Tips==
*The weapon's high [[status chance]] and high innate {{D|Slash}} damage makes {{D|Viral}} builds effective.

==Trivia==
*The Fusilai was first revealed during Warframe Partners Shul's and InexpensiveGamer's Twitch stream on October 4, 2017.
*The Fusilai is the only throwing knife to have an animated projectile, spinning vertically as it flies. This spin, however, is in reverse compared to that of an actual thrown knife.
*{{WF|Gara Prime}} did not come with a primed version of the Fusilai.

{{ver|35.5.8}}
*Fixed the glass on Fusilai being very bright in GI lighting areas. 

{{ver|27.2}}
;Greater than 100% Status having meaning:
Shotguns have a unique Role here based on a very patch-work history with how they interact with Status Chance. A Shotgun that shoots 99% Status Chance would give you 35% (roughly) status per pellet. 100% Status Gives you 100% Status per pellet. This huge jump in performance happens with just a 1% gain - why? Well, to answer that we have to look at our choice to make what the UI conveys reality. It would feel broken to shoot a Shotgun with 100% Status and not see a perfect spread of Effects. In reality, to make Status consistent we have to treat Shotguns as a special case.

Alternate between stealthy short-range electrical discharge, and automatic lightning gun. Faster mode-switch when used by Wisp.}} {{For|the mod|Fulmination}} The '''Fulmin''' is {{WF|Wisp}}'s [[Signature Weapon|signature]] rifle. By default it fires silent {{D|Electricity}} pulses at close range akin to the {{Weapon|Arca Plasmor}}, but via [[Alternate Fire]] it can be converted into an automatic weapon that shoots a rapid stream of lightning at a distance. The mode-switching is sped up when used by Wisp. ==Characteristics== *This weapon deals primarily {{D|Electricity}} damage. *Semi-auto mode: **Shots have a guaranteed {{D|Impact}} proc to enemies up to 9 meters. ***Distance is affected by [[Projectile Speed]]. **Projectiles have a thickness of 1 meter. *Does not use ammo pickups; ammo regenerates over time. **Has a '''1''' second delay after the weapon stops firing before regenerating ammo. Then, regenerates '''30''' ammo per second; takes '''2''' seconds to regenerate a fully depleted battery excluding the delay. **Does not receive benefit from reload-triggered mods such as {{M|Spring-Loaded Chamber}}. *[[Alternate Fire]] mode-switching is '''not''' instantaneous and has an animation of '''1''' second ('''0.5''' seconds when wielded by {{WF|Wisp}}.) {{Advantages| *Semi-auto mode: **Innate 3 meter [[punch through]] against bodies. **[[Silent]]. *Full-auto mode: **Hitscan and pinpoint [[accuracy]]. *{{M|Heavy Caliber}}'s accuracy penalty is minimal on this weapon. }} {{Disadvantages| *Semi-auto mode: **Has linear damage falloff from 100% to 33.33% from 10m to 20m target distance (distances are affected by [[Projectile Speed]]). **Limited range of 20 meters (can be increased with [[Projectile Speed]] mods). **Consumes 10 ammo per shot. **Has a [[Enemy Body Parts|headshot]] multiplier of 1x. **Innate [[punch through]] does not apply to surfaces if hitting with the central portion of the projectile, requiring [[punch through]] mods. *Full-auto mode: **Shots are alarming. }} {{WeaponComparison|Fulmin Prime}} ==Acquisition== The Fulmin's blueprint can be purchased from the [[Market]]. {{BuildAutomatic|type=Weapon}} It can be sold for '''7,500'''. ==Notes== *When wielded by {{WF|Wisp}}/{{WF|Wisp Prime}}, the [[Alternate Fire]] mode-switching animation is decreased to '''0.5''' seconds. *Being categorized as an assault rifle, Fulmin can't be used for "Shotgun Only" Sorties (despite having pulse-shotgun characteristics). ==Tips== *This weapon benefits from guaranteed {{D|Slash}} status effect mods: **Due to its high [[critical chance]] and [[critical multiplier]], it pairs well with {{M|Hunter Munitions}}, which extends to both primary and secondary fire, and works at its full effective range. **Due to its semi auto fire guaranteeing {{D|Impact}} procs, and having a low rate of fire (below 2.5), Fulmin pairs particularly well with {{M|Internal Bleeding}}. However, it will only have an effect at the range at which Impact procs are applied, which is shorter than it's effective range; full auto fire does not benefit from this mod at all. **Despite both these mods technically being slottable at once, the procs caused by them don't stack. *{{M|Heavy Caliber}}'s accuracy loss has minimal effect on this weapon in either fire mode. ==Trivia== *Fulmin is derived from ''[[wiktionary:fulmen|fulmen]]'', the Latin word for lightning. It is the root of the English word [[wiktionary:fulmination|Fulmination]]. *The Fulmin has a unique weapon animation when switching to automatic mode, where the suppressor portion of the weapon is removed and then placed to the side of the weapon. This also gives the Fulmin a unique grip stance where the Warframe's left hand holds the suppressor to the right of the weapon while bracing the weapon from underneath with its wrist. **The Fulmin's suppressor is held in the Warframe's hand if the player brings up the Main Menu while the weapon is in automatic mode. *When a Fulmin-wielding [[Specter]] and [[Spectralyst]] runs out of ammo, it'll reload the weapon instead of waiting for it to recharge. A similar discrepancy can be seen with [[Elite Crewman|Elite Crewmen]] and their {{Weapon|Flux Rifle}}s. ==Bugs== *Sometimes when switching modes quickly the position of the hand and the silencer will bug, combining the silencer with the gun and positioning the players hand as if it was in the semi mode. *{{M|Galvanized Aptitude}} is multiplicative to base damage sources on direct hits from Semi mode. ==Media== File:Tim-bergholz-chamferzone-com-wisp-rifle.jpg|Wisp with the Fulmin File:Tim-bergholz-chamferzone-com-screenshot101.jpg File:Tim-bergholz-chamferzone-com-screenshot102.jpg File:Tim-bergholz-chamferzone-com-screenshot110.jpg File:Tim-bergholz-chamferzone-com-screenshot111.jpg File:Fulmin Arsenal.png|Fulmin as shown in the Arsenal File:Fulmin Arsenal 2.png {{VideoGallery |{{YouTube|Kvcxdt3TXh0|size=300px}} }} {{SkinGallery}} ==Patch History== {{Scrollbox/Article| {{ver|37}} *Updated the Fulmin’s passive to indicate their forced Impact Status Effect on Semi mode at close range. **Now reads: “Alternate Fire switches between Semi and Auto firing modes. Semi mode deals an Impact Status Effect to enemies at close range. Switch speed is doubled when wielded by Wisp.” {{ver|33.5}} *Improved the positioning of the Fulmin’s primary projectile fire VFX. {{ver|33}} *The following weapons can now be found in their corresponding categories in the Arsenal when searching using the tag “Battery”: **Fulmin {{ver|32.0.2}} ;Ammo Changes & Review: When we were reviewing ammo acquisition as a whole for Update 32, we felt weapons with Ammo Regen Rate Overrides, or “Battery,” in particular, needed a place within the ecosystem of change we had established. That said, upon review of feedback, we recognize we were a bit heavy-handed with the changes we made to Battery weapons. We have restored their original values for the time being while we reassess how we can better approach these weapons. We have restored the original values for the following weapons: *Fulmin: **Returned ammo regen rate to 30/s from 20/s **Returned Alt fire ammo requirement to 10 from 15 {{ver|32}} ;Ammo Changes We understand the power fantasy of these weapons is very popular for some, so our first approach was to keep them powerful, but limit how often they can be used by making changes to ammo pick-up. '''We also increased the alt fire ammo requirement per projectile:''' '''Fulmin:''' *Increased Alt fire ammo requirement from 10 to 15. '''''Ammo Pickup Overrides'''''
The following weapons now have ammo pickup overrides, meaning they gain less from picking up ammo. This mostly applies to AoE weapons, in hopes that players will become more deliberate with their aim to make the most of their Ammo pools. The following lists the specific ammo pick up overrides per weapon category. '''Primary Weapons with Ammo Regen Rates Overrides:''' *Fulmin: From 30/s to 20/s {{ver|31.5.9}} *Fixed Fulmin’s projectile explosion FX offset. {{ver|28}} *Fixed Cephalite enemies having blown out FX if killed with a Fulmin. {{ver|27.0.7}} *Fixed Fulmin (only when reduced to below 10 rounds on Semi-Auto firing mode) not recharging correctly. {{ver|25.8}} ;October 2019 Riven Disposition Change *Fulmin: 1->0.8 {{ver|25.7}} *Fixed Fulmin mode swap animation not playing when used in Archwing over the Plains or the Orb Vallis. {{ver|25.2.4}} *Fixed Fulmin's firing mode / appearance can become desynced if transition is interrupted by Wisp’s Wil-O-Wisp ability. {{ver|25.0.4}} *Terminal Velocity can now be used with the Fulmin. *Aligned Fulmin's auto fire mode FX to better align with muzzle. *Fixed issue with Fulmin silencer not properly attaching to player's hand when exiting Submersible Archwing if the weapon was previously in Alt-Fire mode. *Fixed zoom multiplier issues with the Fulmin as reported [https://www.reddit.com/r/Warframe/comments/btea7g/the_fulmin_doesnt_respond_well_to_being_unequipped/ here] {{ver|25.0.3}} *Fixed an issue that made Arca Plasmor, Fulmin and Catchmoon projectiles deal damage twice on the hit when the projectile is destroyed. This was not a case of ‘always worked this way’ as it was accidentally introduced by the Jovian Concord. {{ver|25}} *Introduced. }} {{ver/Lu|25}} ==See also== *{{Weapon|Arca Plasmor}}, a Corpus shotgun that fires a similar projectile. *[[Catchmoon]], a [[Kitgun]] chamber that fires a similar projectile. {{WeaponNav}} [[es:Fulmin]] [[fr: Fulmin]] [[Category:Update 25]] [[Category:Primary Weapons]] [[Category:Tenno]] [[Category:Silent]] [[Category:Battery Weapons]] [[Category:Wisp]] [[Category:Signature Weapons]] [[uk:Фульмін]]

==Notes==
*When the buff times out, one stack is lost and the buff duration resets.

== Trivia ==

* Currently, there are no Galvanized counterparts of this mod for primary rifle/primary beam weapons, nor secondary/secondary beam weapons (there are no Galvanized variants of {{M|Terminal Velocity}}, {{M|Sinister Reach}}, {{M|Lethal Momentum}} and {{M|Ruinous Extension}}). 
** Similarly, while primary rifles and secondaries have access to {{M|Galvanized Scope}} and {{M|Galvanized Crosshairs}}, both of which are Galvanized variants of {{M|Argon Scope}} and {{M|Hydraulic Crosshairs}}, primary shotguns do not have a Galvanized variant of {{M|Laser Sight}}, which functions identically to the two mods mentioned (but grants a slightly lower critical chance bonus). It is unknown why Laser Sight, while also being a mod that dropped from the Acolyte [[Torment]] in the past, did not receive this treatment.
* Interestingly, this mod combines the effects of two mods, namely {{M|Fatal Acceleration}} and {{M|Sinister Reach}} into one, granting bonus projectile speed and beam length, whereas the former (the mod that Galvanized Acceleration is based on) offers only bonus projectile speed.
** This may be because the developers did not want to create an extra Galvanized range mod for beam shotguns (like the {{Weapon|Phantasma}}) and thus simply combined both effects into one mod.
*** Galvanized mods were released in batches of 3 for each weapon type they were made for (primary rifles, primary shotguns and secondaries), and since the other two slots for Galvanized shotgun mods were taken up by {{M|Galvanized Savvy}} and {{M|Galvanized Hell}}, it is possible the developers decided to combine the two shotgun mods mentioned into one, to avoid making an extra Galvanized mod for primary shotguns.

''' Furis Incarnon Genesis''' is an item that is used to add [[Incarnon]] upgrades to the {{Weapon|Furis}} or {{Weapon|1=Mk1-Furis}}.

==Acquisition==
*Upon completion of [[The Duviri Paradox]] and [[Angels of the Zariman]], and unlocking [[The Steel Path]], players can earn {{Resource|1=Furis Incarnon Genesis}} from [[The Circuit]]'s Steel Path to place on their Furis with the help of [[Cavalero]] in the [[Chrysalith]]. This [[Incarnon Genesis]] form grants it evolutions to a transformation and newfound strength.
*Purchased from Cavalero for {{pc|120}}, complete with the resources used in its installation. This purchase can only be made '''once'''.

==Incarnon Genesis==

* Installing the Furis Incarnon Genesis requires 20 {{Resource|Pathos Clamp|Pathos Clamps}}, 70 {{Resource|Yao Shrub|Yao Shrubs}}, and 80 {{Resource|Lamentus}}.
** When installed, the first Evolution tier is unlocked. Each challenge additionally grants 5,000 [[affinity]] to the weapon, affected by [[Affinity Booster]]s.

===Overview===
* Incarnon Form is charged by filling the Incarnon Transmutation gauge that appears under the reticle by achieving [[Enemy Body Parts|weakpoint hits]] and then pressing the [[Alternate Fire]] button. '''20''' weakpoints hits will completely fill the gauge. A full gauge is not required to activate Incarnon Form.
**Charges '''do''' generate when hitting weak points highlighted by {{A|Sonar}} or {{M|Detect Vulnerability}}. 
***However, they do not generate from hits on {{A|Crystallize}}'s crystalline growths.
** Weakpoints on corpses or [[Invulnerable]] targets do '''not''' build charges.
** Individual [[Multishot]] bullets can build charges.
* Mode switching is '''not''' instantaneous and has an animation equal to the weapon's [[reload speed]].
* Swapping to and from Incarnon Form will fully reload the normal form's magazine.
* Instead of drawing ammunition from its reserves, the Furis's Incarnon Form uses a separate "magazine" with each charge producing '''14''' rounds to a maximum of '''280'''. Once all ammunition is expended, the Furis reverts to its normal form.
** Incarnon Form's magazine is '''not''' affected by mods.
** Incarnon Form is '''not''' affected by [[Ammo Efficiency]] (such as {{A|Energized Munitions}}).
** Charges and Incarnon Form persists through all activities, such as holstering, [[bleedout]], or being [[disarm]]ed. However, charges and Incarnon Form are removed upon [[death]].

'''Fulmin Prime''' is the [[Prime]]d counterpart of the {{Weapon|Fulmin}} rifle, with increased [[Magazine Size]], faster [[Reload]] delay, improvements to the semi-automatic damage and [[Status Chance]], and full-auto [[Critical Chance]]. Fulmin Prime was released alongside {{WF|Wisp Prime}} and {{Weapon|Gunsen Prime}}.

==Characteristics==
*This weapon deals primarily {{D|Electricity}} damage.
*Semi-auto mode:
**Shots have a guaranteed {{D|Impact}} proc to enemies up to 9 meters.
***Distance is affected by [[Projectile Speed]].
**Projectiles have a thickness of 1 meter.
*Does not use ammo pickups; ammo regenerates over time.
**Has a '''0.7''' second delay after the weapon stops firing before regenerating ammo. Then, regenerates '''40''' ammo per second; takes '''2''' seconds to regenerate a fully depleted battery excluding the delay.
**Does not receive benefit from reload-triggered mods such as {{M|Spring-Loaded Chamber}}.
*[[Alternate Fire]] mode-switching is '''not''' instantaneous and has an animation of '''1''' second ('''0.5''' seconds when wielded by {{WF|Wisp}}/{{WF|Wisp Prime}}.)

{{Advantages|
*Semi-auto mode:
**Innate 3 meter [[punch through]] against bodies.
**[[Silent]].
*Full-auto mode:
**Hitscan and pinpoint [[accuracy]].
*{{M|Heavy Caliber}}'s accuracy penalty is minimal on this weapon.
}}

{{Disadvantages|
*Semi-auto mode:
**Has linear damage falloff from 100% to 33.33% from 10m to 20m target distance (distances are affected by [[Projectile Speed]]).
**Limited range of 20 meters (can be increased with [[Projectile Speed]] mods).
**Consumes 10 ammo per shot.
**Has a [[Enemy Body Parts|headshot]] multiplier of 1x.
**Innate [[punch through]] does not apply to surfaces if hitting with the central portion of the projectile, requiring [[punch through]] mods.
*Full-auto mode:
**Shots are alarming.
}}
